behaviour.hover: card translateY(-2px) + shadow 0 4px 8px rgba(2,0,0,.08) (300ms ease-out); arrow #e0e0e0 -> #d52331 and translateX 8px
behaviour.mobile (<768): description and arrow hidden; icon and 16px title centred

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Icon + h3 + description link cards in a fixed 2-column grid, lift and arrow-move on hover; mobile shows icon and title only

cells: text (richtext): icon token paragraph (:heroicons-<name>:), h3 with the link, description p

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, one rich-text cell: icon token paragraph (:heroicons-user-plus:), h3 containing the link, description paragraph

usage: Home 'Service & technical support' section (section style off-white split).
reuseGuidance: Service / feature link cards with a Heroicon. Icons live in /icons as heroicons-<name>.svg.
